name: Afforestation — seeding efficiency and the 8× edge-hostility lever
summary: Gives seeding efficiency e = C·(3Δμ/(2aσ))³ (established canopy per seed), the critical nucleus and barrier, and the proven lever: halving edge hostility σ multiplies efficiency by exactly 8.

inputs.name: sigma
inputs.help: Edge hostility σ — surface-tension-like penalty on establishing edges (site prep such as nurse plants or mulch lowers it). Positive.

inputs.name: delta_mu
inputs.help: Site suitability Δμ — ecological drive favouring establishment. Positive.

inputs.name: establishment_constant
inputs.help: Establishment constant C that scales efficiency (default 1).

outputs.name: seeding_efficiency
outputs.unit: established canopy per seed (scaled by C)

outputs.name: efficiency_if_edge_hostility_halved
outputs.unit: established canopy per seed (scaled by C)

hypotheses.statement: The edge hostility σ is positive.
The site suitability Δμ is positive.
The shape factor a is positive when supplied.
The establishment constant C is positive when supplied.

scope: Deterministic theorem-backed computation; empirical input validity is external.
boundary: Model outputs do not establish field suitability, seed availability, land rights, permits, or ecological success. The result is conditional on the supplied inputs; it does not establish empirical validity, Viridis review, certification, a credit, or a registry determination.
